betReadinessPrerequisites: no model superiority claim is implied

earlier.definition: maximum absolute top-class confidence gap across qualifying 0.1-wide bands within each temporal fold, then maximum across folds; minimum 1,000 rows per fold-band

final.definition: maximum absolute top-class confidence gap across qualifying 0.1-wide bands after pooling all five OOF folds; minimum 1,000 rows per pooled band

decisionRules.materialRegression: at >=100 paired games, primary CI lower bound > +0.020; the same V18-minus-Gen1 orientation is used
decisionRules.noninferiority: at >=250 paired games, primary CI upper bound < +0.020 and superiority is not established
decisionRules.secondaryMetrics: diagnostic except operational coverage, calibration safety, illegal states, and termination
decisionRules.superiority: at >=250 paired games, primary CI upper bound < 0 and operational/calibration gates pass
decisionRules.unresolved: failure to prove superiority or noninferiority is not equivalence; continue or retain only as diversity challenger

formalInference.cohortRule: Each formal look uses the first 250 or 500 chronologically eligible paired games, respectively.
formalInference.familywiseRule: Bonferroni fixed allocation: alpha 0.025 at each of two formal looks; total alpha no greater than 0.05.
formalInference.invocationRule: A formalLook declaration must be immutable and identify look 1 or 2; reports without it are descriptive only.
formalInference.operationalIndependence: Operational failures may trigger immediate action without statistical performance inference.
formalInference.regressionRule: Formal material-regression claims use the same allocated interval and temporal-block minimum.

monteCarlo.commonRandomNumbers: Allowed only when both scenarios persist the same seed lineage and transition draws; otherwise unavailable.
monteCarlo.display: probability with Monte Carlo SE and 95% sampling interval, explicitly excluding model uncertainty
monteCarlo.interpretability: Differences smaller than the larger forecast's 95% Monte Carlo half-width are simulation-indistinguishable.
monteCarlo.laterQualification: Reassess paths or variance reduction only after runtime and observed MC contribution are measured; no requirement is changed here.

developmentEvidence.limitation: PA-level multiclass endpoint; not the prospective whole-game home-win endpoint.
Different game engines and evidence population; does not approve a V18-versus-Gen1 margin.

noninferiorityMargin.intendedUse: A practical prospective tolerance for paired home-win log loss, if separately approved before outcomes are used for that decision.
noninferiorityMargin.justification: Existing Development evidence supports continued monitoring but does not scientifically approve a +0.020 whole-game loss tolerance.

planningBasis.definition: 1.96 times the assumed standard error; not a powered minimum detectable effect
planningBasis.interpretation: Planning-only correlated-forecast assumption; decisions use the actual paired block-bootstrap CI and never move the 0.020 margin.

repeatedLooks.alphaAllocation: 0.025 at each formal look, yielding a two-sided 97.5% interval at each look.
repeatedLooks.earlyCheckpoints: 20, 50, and 100 are descriptive; operational failures remain actionable.
repeatedLooks.formal: Only immutable LOOK_250 and LOOK_500 declarations invoke formal inference.
